subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Impasse
solution:
The correct answer is Deadlock.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Impasse' is 'Deadlock'.
 
• Impasse (गतिरोध): a difficult situation in which no progress can be made because the people involved cannot agree what to do.(एक कठिन परिस्थिति जिसमें कोई प्रगति नहीं हो सकती क्योंकि इसमें शामिल लोग इस बात पर सहमत नहीं हो पा रहे हैं कि क्या किया जाए)
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Deadlock: a situation in which two sides cannot reach an agreement (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दो पक्ष किसी समझौते पर नहीं पहुंच सकते)
 
• Peaceful: not wanting or involving war, violence or argument (युद्ध, हिंसा या तर्क-वितर्क नहीं चाहता या उसमें शामिल नहीं होना)
 
• Resolution: the quality of being firm and determined (दृढ़ और दृढ़ निश्चयी होने का गुण)
 
• Harmony: a state of agreement or of peaceful existence together (सहमति की स्थिति या एक साथ शांतिपूर्ण अस्तित्व)
 
 

 Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.​
